co.n: Angles in Triangles and Polygons Cohort

c.p: What is the sum of interior angles in any Euclidean triangle?
c.h: It equals a straight line in degrees.
c.e: The interior angles of every standard triangle sum exactly to 180°.
r: 360° is the sum of interior angles of a quadrilateral.

c.p: In an isosceles triangle, how many angles are guaranteed to be equal in measure?
c.h: An equilateral has 3 equal angles, but an isosceles has fewer.
c.e: An isosceles triangle has two equal sides and two equal base angles.
r: A triangle with 3 equal angles is an equilateral triangle.
A triangle with no equal angles is a scalene triangle.
